warnings: The Fleet Air Arm is part of the Royal Navy, not RAF Fighter/Coastal Command; do not lose it inside Royal Air Force totals.
The quoted 1945 figures refer to the Royal Navy's whole FAA at war-in-Europe end, which still had forces outside Europe; no Europe-only total is established.
1939 frontline available-to-operate differs in definition from 1945 total aircraft; a 1939-to-1945 growth ratio would be misleading until denominators are made comparable.
No comprehensive FAA pilot deaths, squadron losses, claims, theater-specific sorties or map coordinates have been directly transcribed; original ADM series require archival access.
